title: A fair agreement after old routines end

captions.physics: Recognising actual work within domestic life

meaning: Your domestic agreement renews when a former form can end without accusing someone of no longer respecting shared rules.
text: You can create domestic support through fair division: considering the load, fulfilling promises and recognising the other’s participation. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes these actions. The Hierophant in energy tests your footing through a compulsory model that should survive regardless of current needs. Death in emotions experiences the ending of a former domestic form. A familiar agreement may therefore seem correct and stop feeling yours simultaneously: some conditions have ended, but recognising change feels difficult when altering form means losing respect for everything that once sustained two people.

For example, cleaning was divided by room. One room is now used differently, changing its workload beyond the former allocation. **Respect for the past need not preserve its conditions forever.** Recognising the old scheme’s end does not cancel invested effort. Fairness returns to today’s reality without domestic life maintaining inconvenience merely to prove you still value agreement and responsibility towards each other.

The difficulty is defending the model against change itself. Someone seems obliged to admit being wrong before correction is permitted. Conversation grows heavier while present discomfort stays. Support becomes firmer when an ending may be an ordinary transition and a new division need not declare the former shared routine mistaken or dishonest. Earlier care can remain valued within an arrangement that now works differently.
